Let a = log₂x, b = log₂y, c = log₂z, and k = log₂3. Taking log₂ of each equation gives

- a(b+c) = 8 + 4k
- b(c+a) = 9 + 6k
- c(a+b) = 5 + 10k

Set p = ab, q = bc, r = ca. Then

- p + r = 8 + 4k
- p + q = 9 + 6k
- q + r = 5 + 10k

Adding these gives p + q + r = 11 + 10k, so p = 6, q = 3 + 6k, r = 2 + 4k.

Then (abc)² = pqr = 6·3(1+2k)·2(1+2k) = 36(1+2k)², so abc = ±6(1+2k).

**Case abc = 6(1+2k):** a = abc/q = 2, b = abc/r = 3, c = abc/p = 1 + 2k.
Check: 2(4+2k) = 8+4k ✓, 3(3+2k) = 9+6k ✓, (1+2k)·5 = 5+10k ✓.
Then a + b + c = 6 + 2k, so xyz = 2⁶·3² = 576.

**Case abc = −6(1+2k):** every sign flips, so (a, b, c) = (−2, −3, −(1+2k)). The products ab, bc, ca are unchanged, so all three equations still hold, and x, y, z are still positive reals.
Then a + b + c = −6 − 2k, so xyz = 2⁻⁶·3⁻² = 1/576.

The smallest possible value is 1/576.

ANSWER: 1/576
